projects.title: Projects
projects.summaryPlaceholder:
An overview of my projects. My main stack is Java and Angular, but I'm happy to adapt to new languages and frameworks when the situation calls for it.

Click below to see more details.

project-alpha.title: Project Alpha
project-alpha.summary: A collaborative web application built with a distributed team.
project-alpha.description: Project Alpha is a full-stack web application developed in collaboration with an international team. The project features real-time collaboration tools, user authentication, and a responsive design that works across all devices.

open-source-lib.title: Open Source Library
open-source-lib.summary: Contributing to an open source UI component library.
open-source-lib.description: Contributed multiple components to a popular open source UI library. Implemented accessibility features and wrote comprehensive unit tests. The contributions improved the library's ARIA support and added new interactive components.

personal-website.title: Personal Portfolio
personal-website.summary: Webapp that showcases my projects and skills.
personal-website.description: A modern, responsive portfolio website built with Angular and Tailwind CSS. Features include internationalization support (English/Italian), dark theme, and smooth animations. Deployed on GitHub Pages.

task-manager.title: Task Manager App
task-manager.summary: A productivity app for managing daily tasks and goals.
task-manager.description: A feature-rich task management application with drag-and-drop functionality, recurring tasks, and progress tracking. Built with a mobile-first approach and includes offline support via PWA features.

university-project.title: University Thesis Project
university-project.summary: Machine learning research project for image classification.
university-project.description: A research project exploring convolutional neural networks for image classification. Achieved 95% accuracy on the test dataset and documented findings in a published thesis paper.

flashcard-app.title: Flashcard Learning App
flashcard-app.summary: An educational app using spaced repetition for learning.
flashcard-app.description: A simple but effective flashcard application that uses spaced repetition algorithms to optimize learning. Featured user-generated decks and progress statistics.

monthly-expenses-app.title: Monthly Expenses
monthly-expenses-app.summary: A mobile app for tracking personal expenses and budgeting.
monthly-expenses-app.description: A cross-platform mobile application built with Ionic and Angular for tracking daily expenses. Features include expense categorization, monthly budget overview, visual charts, and data export. Available for both Android and iOS devices.

smart-rockets.title: Smart Rockets
smart-rockets.summary: A genetic algorithm simulation showing rocket evolution.
smart-rockets.description: A school project demonstrating genetic algorithms through rocket navigation. Users can draw obstacle paths and watch rockets evolve across generations to reach the goal. Features editable parameters including learning rate, population size, and gene mutation randomness.

about.title: Who am I
about.name: Gbohou Indji Israel
about.bioPlaceholder:
I've been working as a Full stack developer since 2022, with concrete experience in the banking sector and a curiosity for progress, especially in AI. In my private time, I immerse myself in both personal and collaborative projects, preferring Agile-style team work.

Calmness and serenity always accompany work quality, which is why I like to say that "smiles go for miles".
